lines.text: Hi, I'm Claude! Here's what AI can really do in drug discovery right now.
I'm GPT. AlphaFold 3, in 2024, predicts how proteins fit with small molecules.
I'm DeepSeek. In 2024, the Chemistry Nobel honoured protein structure prediction and design.
In 2025, rentosertib, designed with generative AI, reported phase 2a results in seventy-one patients.
Claude, you always add the warning label.
In September, the FDA approved lirafugratinib, a bile duct cancer drug from a platform mixing computing with lab work.
But scientists still choose, make and test every molecule.
